name: WPSQR Site Cleaner
author: wpsqr

sections.description:
WPSQR Site Cleaner simplifies the task of decluttering your WordPress site by identifying and deleting duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types. This helps improve your website’s loading speed and overall performance.

Why Choose WPSQR Site Cleaner?

  • Find and Remove Duplicates: Detect and delete duplicates from posts, pages, or any custom post types you select. Includes options for title and related metadata.
  • Optimize Space: Frees up storage space by removing unnecessary duplicates, which enhances website performance.
  • Handles All Site Sizes: Efficiently manages and optimizes websites of all sizes without causing timeouts.

Key Features

  • Selective Deletion: Choose specific posts or pages to delete.
  • Post Status Selection: Filter duplicates based on post statuses.
  • Comparison Method: Select your preferred comparison method to find duplicates.
  • Version Control: Decide whether to keep the oldest or newest version of a post.
  • Redirection Options: Redirect deleted posts to existing posts if desired.
  • Manage Duplicates: Remove duplicates individually or in bulk.
  • Add Redirects: Manually add redirects for posts without deleting them.
  • Update Redirects: Update existing redirects as needed.
  • Activity Log: Track all plugin activities for review.

Experience Its Efficiency

Site Cleaner’s approach ensures your website remains stable while progressively improving performance. The plugin handles large datasets without causing site timeouts, making your WordPress site cleaner and more efficient.

WPSQR Site Cleaner is the ideal tool for removing duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types effortlessly, leading to a faster and more efficient WordPress site.

Troubleshooting

  1. Ensure the WPSQR Site Cleaner plugin is activated and your WordPress version is at least 5.2.
  2. Deactivate other plugins to check for conflicts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpsqr-site-cleaner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the WPSQR Site Cleaner plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the plugin via Settings -> WPSQR Site Cleaner.
sections.faq:
Should I back up my site before using this tool?

Yes, it is strongly recommended to back up your site before deleting posts or pages.

What if the plugin deletes something I didn’t want to delete?

Deleted items are moved to the trash, from where they can be restored. You can also restore from the backup you made before using the plugin.

Is WPSQR Site Cleaner safe for large websites?

Absolutely. The plugin is optimized to handle large databases without causing timeouts or performance issues.

Does WPSQR Site Cleaner work with custom post types?

Yes, WPSQR Site Cleaner supports all registered custom post types on your site.

Is there documentation available?

Yes, you can find comprehensive documentation on our website at WPSQR-Site-Cleaner Documentation.
